request_path: Read-only SQLite precheck validates identity and all persisted immutable-trigger definitions before opening read/write.

startup_path: Explicit initializer creates a new binding and all three immutable guards in one transaction.
Existing bound databases, including valid restored databases, must already contain the expected guards; missing or altered guards fail closed.
Legacy sandbox adoption remains possible only through explicit startup initialization. Existing unbound application databases cannot be adopted into preproduction or production.
